text:
Anita H.: Heads-up — planning a small desk-drop postcard campaign next week to encourage peer nominations for the Q3 recognition program. Short hand-signed postcards + QR to nomination form. Who can help with distribution in NY / SF / London / remote kits? Need volunteers and rough counts by EOD Friday. :sparkles:

Samir K.: Love it. I can do SF (Floor 5). How many postcards per person?

Anita H.: Aiming 1 per person + a few extras. Estimate ~220 total across offices. Budget ~ $150 for printing + shipping. Remote kits = ~60 (ship as padded envelopes).

Maria P.: I can handle packaging + ship labels for remote. I'll need an address column on the sheet.

Jordan L.: I'll take NYC (HQ floors 2-3). Can we get bilingual cards (EN/FR)?

Anita H.: Good call — yes let's order bilingual. @Lee T. (HR Ops) can you confirm we can include the nomination QR & a short eligibility blurb?

Lee T.: Yep, approved. Keep it simple — "Nominate a teammate for our Q3 recognition awards — open to all full-time and contractors who've been here 3+ months." I'll add the legal-approved blurb to the sheet.

Samir K.: Volunteer rota? I can do morning drop Thu 10–11am SF.

Maria P.: I can assemble remote kits Wed afternoon. Need pickup spot? Anita?

Anita H.: I'll pick up prints Wed 3pm from the print shop (Mission St). Draft drop schedule below: 

```text
Wed 3pm - Anita picks up prints
Wed 4pm - Maria assembles remote kits (HQ shipping room)
Thu 9am - Jordan + volunteers drop NYC desks (floors 2-3)
Thu 10am - Samir + volunteers drop SF desks (floor 5)
Fri 9am - Lee + volunteers drop London desks (Meeting Room A)
Fri 1pm - Final postage confirmation + expense submit
```

Jordan L.: I need 2 volunteers for NYC, pinging @Olivia and @Devon.

Anita H.: Great — Olivia and Devon confirmed. Maria — can you share the sheet link so we can add counts/addresses?

Maria P.: Here’s the sheet: https://go.redwood/sheets/postcard-drop — please fill in 'office', 'desk count', 'ship address' and add any dietary/allergy notes for remote care kits.

HR Ops Bot: Reminder: please submit expenses within 7 days of event using /expense. Template: project=Culture, code=REC-Q3.

Samir K.: I'll submit after pickup. Quick Q: does the postcard content call out managers? Prefer to keep it peer-driven.

Lee T.: Keep it peer-driven but allow manager nominations — label the form section 'Peer & Manager nominations'.

Anita H.: Final asks: need 1 more SF volunteer and someone to take photos for marketing/socials. @Paul? @Tracy?

Paul M.: I can take photos in SF and upload to #marketing-assets.

Tracy B.: I can be the extra SF volunteer Thu 10.

Anita H.: Amazing — thanks everyone. I’ll update the sheet with final counts and post a short heads-up in #general the day before. :heart:
